title: Moving My Game from Three.js to Godot | Heartwoodfall Devlog
description:
I'm moving Heartwoodfall from Three.js to Godot — rebuilding the code while keeping the original project's visual direction.

Read the full devlog on Medium:
https://medium.com/@21zerixpm/godot-claude-opuse-5-5-a583f14a39fa

Claude helped me fix character movement. Now the original project guides the characters, environments, and interface for the Godot rebuild. Some 3D assets may carry over, but reuse still needs testing.

Subscribe for more game development content.

Article screenshots and animated typography; not live gameplay footage. English narration made with local Kokoro. Edited and rendered in JDH Shorts Studio.
